contamination_reason: Measured a superseded suite. distractor_resolution prompts selected on the TOPIC ("shipping delays"), which spans the shipping_delay and shipping_minor signals; one customer holds both, so the target was not uniquely identifiable. Fixed in tasks v5 by selecting at signal grain. Suite hash changed.
detection_mechanism: analyze_p3_baseline: SUP-distract-001/002 failing 10/10 with an identical wrong_entity signature, then trajectory inspection
why_retained: Deleting a contaminated run hides how the contamination happened. The data is unusable; the evidence is not.
